label: Resolvase KAP NTPase system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded, resolvase- and KAP NTPase-associated prokaryotic Schlafen nuclease locus.
observations: Resolvase_KAP_NTPase-associated Schlafen branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual Schlafen proteins, individual prokaryotic schlafen genes, non-Resolvase_KAP_NTPase Schlafen nuclease architectures, general KAP NTPase-domain or resolvase activities outside a complete anti-phage Schlafen system, and the DefenseFinder Resolvase_KAP_NTPase source key outside a complete organism-level system.
